headline: Approved policies, meeting calendar edits, 403(b) plan, and declined to pursue staff termination hearing
summary: The committee approved personnel actions, two policies on second read, edits to the meeting calendar, and adoption of a restated 403(b) plan. After executive session, the committee voted not to move forward with a termination hearing for Staff A, then held a second executive session on a legal matter.
decisions: Approved the second read of policies JE (Student Attendance) and GBN (Family and Medical Leave), 6-0.
Agenda item #6 was withdrawn by Meghan Hird and Elizabeth Eames.
Approved the School Committee Meeting Calendar with edits, 5-1 (L. Jensen opposed).
Approved adoption of the restated 403(b) Plan, 6-0.
Voted to enter executive session to discuss a personal matter, 6-0.
Voted not to move forward with a termination hearing for Staff A, 6-0.
Voted to enter executive session on a legal matter, 6-0.

decision_evidence.quote: VOTED: (1) Motion to approve the 2nd read of the following policies: a. JE – Student Attendance b. GBN – Family and Medical Leave Meghan Hird – Luke Jensen (6-0).
At 6:02 pm agenda item #6 was withdrawn by Meghan Hird and Elizabeth Eames.
VOTED: (2) Motion to approve with edits. Meghan Hird – Scott Harriman (5-1) L. Jensen
VOTED: (3) Motion to approve the adoption of the restated 403(b) Plan. Meghan Hird – Elizabeth Eames (6-0).
VOTED: (4) Motion To enter into executive session to discuss a personal matter in accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6) (A). Meghan Hird – Luke Jensen (6-0).
VOTED: (5) Motion to not move forward with termination hearing for Staff A. Elizabeth Eames – Meghan Hird (6-0)
VOTED: (6) Motion To enter into executive session on a legal matter in accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6)(E). Meghan Hird – Luke Jensen (6-0).

PUBLIC INPUT 
Ronnie Paradis – The role we need to play in front of our kids. Get involved with schools. Take up 
issues and not people. Find out what is really going on in our schools. Volunteer to read or help at 
schools. Seeking options for students getting involved in Government, campaigns, etc. 
 
POLICIES

VOTED: (1) Motion to approve the 2nd read of the following policies: 
a. JE – Student Attendance 
b. GBN – Family and Medical Leave 
  Meghan Hird – Luke Jensen (6-0). 
 
POLICY ADJUSTMENTS FOR SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
 Superintendent Jake Langlais reviewed policy BDA and policy BE.  
At 6:02 pm agenda item #6 was withdrawn by Meghan Hird and Elizabeth Eames.

 Superintendent Jake Langlais presented. 
VOTED: (2) Motion to approve with edits. Meghan Hird – Scott Harriman (5-1) L. Jensen 
 
RESTATED 403(B) PLAN 
 Superintendent Jake Langlais presented. 
VOTED: (3) Motion to approve the adoption of the restated 403(b) Plan. 
Meghan Hird – Elizabeth Eames (6-0). 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL COMMITTEE CHAIR 
Chairperson Phoenix McLaughlin reported that the Curriculum Subcommittee will start with 
grades/grading. Discussion to follow in September. School updates can be throughout the year. The State 
study on screen time. Do we have data? 
 
REPORT FROM SCHOOL SUPERINTENDENT 
Superintendent Jake Langlais reported that Fall Sports started today. Looking at school programs – 
modified recovery credits at the high school - After 2 program. The start of school is 8/24 for staff 
and 8/26 for kids. There is a film screening done by a Bates professor and students for second 
responders. It will be in Biddeford on Sunday.  
 
REPORT FROM CITY COUNCIL REP 
City Council Representative Scott Harriman reported that the City Council meets tomorrow. Opioid 
Fund Settlement is on the agenda. Questions: Trash can info packets.
MINUTES – LEWISTON SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING HELD AUGUST 17, 2026 – PAGE 5

 Backpack distribution event in conjunction with Summer Fun & Films at Connors on 8/19.
